title: Small Business Electricity Supply Site Transfer Fee: Standard Charge
content:
**Standard.** The standard site transfer fee on a Small Business Electricity Supply agreement is the plan's site transfer fee, rounded half up to the cent; a plan whose transfer fee is zero bills no fee. The plan's site transfer fee is the transfer fee figure the agreement's own plan sets.

## Terms of the standard

- **Reduced fee.** The plan's site transfer fee less any amounts taken off it, never below zero.
- **Fee charged.** The reduced fee.
- **Rounding.** Half up to the cent, only once, at the end.
- **Zero plan fee.** A plan whose transfer fee is zero bills no fee.

## Hypothetical worked example

An agreement whose plan sets a hypothetical transfer fee of 45.00 USD: the reduced fee is 45.00 USD, the fee charged is 45.00 USD and, rounded half up to the cent at the end, 45.00 USD is billed.

A hypothetical plan setting a transfer fee of zero bills no fee, and the fee entered for the move is 0.00.
